chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin komau in tua nasepna za ka ngah uh ahih ciangin, a hong hehpihna thupha ka ngah uh mah bangin thanem lungkiatna ka nei kei uh hi.

Zumhuaina tawh kipawl a kiseel nate ka paaikhia zo uh hi. Kikheemna zang loin Pasian’ thu im loin, lumlet loin, thuman a tel takin hilhin Pasian mai-ah mi khempeuh in a kitheihna lungsim tawh hong phat nading phathuaina ka gamta uh hi.
Kote in ka hilh uh Lungdamna Thu in kisin ahih leh, a kisia ding mite tung bekah kisinin a om hi.
Tua bang mite in Pasian’ meel ahi Khazih’ minthan’na tawh a dim Lungdamna Thu khuavak taang a muh theih loh nadingun hih leitung a uk topa in a um lo tua mite’ lungsim mittang uh a tawsak hi.
Kote in komau thu ka hilh kei uh hi. Zeisu Khazih in Topa ahi hi cih ahi zongin, kote in Zeisu Khazih ading note’ sila ka hi uh hi, cih ahi zongin ka hilh uh hi.
“Khua mial sungah khuavak a hong taang ding hi” a ci Pasian in Zeisu Khazih’ maitangah Pasian’ minthan’na theihna a vang hong piak nadingin kote lungsim uhah khuavak a hong tangsak hi.
Ahih hangin a lian mahmah vangliatna in ko kiang pan hi lo, Pasian kiang pan ahih nadingin tua sum leibeel sungah kiguangin kote in ka nei uh hi.
Kote in bawlsiatna apawl apawl ka thuak uh hangin ka phattuamna uh a kiam kei hi, a kingaihsut zawh loh hangin ka lungkia kei uh hi,
delhin hong kibawlsiat hangin hong nusia kei hi, puksakna ka thuak uh hangin kisiatna ka thuak kei uh hi.
Zeisu’ nuntak kikna kote pumpi sung uhah a kilat nadingin Zeisu’ sihna ka pumpi sung uhah ka pua tawntung uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Zeisu’ nuntakna in a si thei komau pumpi sung uhah a kilat nadingin a nungta kote in Zeisu hangin sihna’ khut sungah piakna ka thuak tawntung uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin sihna in kote sungah na hong seem hi. Note sungah ahih leh, nuntakna in na hong sem hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, “Keimah in umin, ka gen hi” ci-a a kigelh mah bangin kote in zong upna lungsim nei ka hih ciangun ka gen uh hi.
Topa Zeisu sihna pan a thosakpa in Zeisu tawh kote zong hong thosak kik ding a, note tawh a kiangah a hong tum khawmsak ding hi cih ka thei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, hehpihna in mite hangin khang a, Pasian’ minthan’na ading hehpihna phatna a kicin’ nadingin na khempeuh note ading ahi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin thanem lungkia loin ka om uh hi. Kote uh pum pua lamah a om mi in a kisiatsiat hangin ka pum sung uhah a om mi in ni khat nung ni khat kibawl thakna a ngah hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, kote maitangah a kilangte in tawlkhat bek kip a,

a kilang lo nate a kip tawntung ahih ciangin a kilang nate en lo ciamteh loin, a kilang lo nate ka en ka ciamteh uh ciangin tawlkhat bek ka thuak uh gimna a zangin a tawntung a gik minthan’ nading a piangsak hi.
